choices.C1_percentile: nearest rank: value number ceil(P/100 x n) of the rates sorted upward
choices.C2_two_groups: largest distance between neighbouring q values divides them; two groups if each side has at least 2 values, the distance is at least 0.10 and larger than the width of each group; labels are used only if also the lower group is below 0.65 and the upper group above 0.85
choices.C3_fastest_half: n//2 fastest threads; with equal rates at the last place the count per mesh is a lowest and a highest value
choices.C4_repeated_launch: the last complete block of a (step, tag) is used; the others are listed under not_used
choices.C5_A4_count_label: label of a count = label of its repetitions if all are equal, else mixed
choices.C7_A4_bracket: the two neighbouring counts between which the label changes are looked for among the counts with threads on both meshes; 64+0 keeps its own label and is left out; a bracket is given only if there is exactly one change and it is between split and uniform
choices.C8_q_of_A3: the write and copy repetitions of the A3 processes with two buffers (--kernel all) are not used for the test of the two groups, because the handoff says to compare only the rows of the read kernel for A3; they are listed under q.rows_left_out
choices.C6_A5_change: low/high sequence without the changing intervals; position = first interval with the new label
choices.C9_level_limits: per CPU over its A5 and A6 rates: a limit does not separate the rates if rates lie on both sides of it and the empty range around it is smaller than 0.25 GB/s; level labels and level changes are used only for a CPU where both limits separate the rates
choices.C10_event_names: cycles = cpu_cycles, instructions = inst_retired, L1 data refills = l1d_cache_refill, L2 data refills = l2d_cache_refill, last-level read misses = ll_cache_miss_rd; l3d_cache_refill is a second candidate for the last
choices.C11_A2_changed_totals: range of (old read total - new read total) per interval = lowest old - highest new to highest old - lowest new; the totals count as changed only if the range with the long interval does not overlap the range with the short interval

decision.reason: the largest distance between neighbouring q values is 0.060, below 0.10; the largest distance is not larger than the width of each group

bracket_compare.64+b: no bracket for at least one kernel
bracket_compare.a+a: no bracket for at least one kernel
